players.bio: Abdelnour Soualhia is a 25-year-old professional football player who plays as a centre-back for the Dutch club SC Telstar. He holds dual citizenship for both France and Algeria. He is currently on loan from the Eredivisie club AZ Alkmaar.
Daan Reiziger is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Telstar.

Emirhan Cüneyt Demircan (born 20 January 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a winger and forward for Eredivisie club Telstar, on loan from Utrecht. Born in Germany, he is a Turkey youth international.
Fabiano Rust is a 21-year-old Dutch professional football player who plays as an attacking midfielder or forward for SC Telstar in the Dutch Eredivisie.

Gabrielle "Gabi" Caschili is a 23-year-old professional football player from the Netherlands who plays as a right-back and midfielder for the Dutch club Telstar in the top-tier Eredivisie league. Born on 14 July 2003 in Emmen, he holds both Dutch and Italian citizenship.
Gerald Alders (born 7 May 2005) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Eredivisie club Telstar, on loan from Ajax.

Henk Brugge is a Dutch professional football manager who is the head coach of the Eredivisie club SC Telstar. Born on 31 July 1977, he took over the role at Telstar for the 2026/27 season, signing a contract that runs until June 2028. Prior to taking this head coaching role, Brugge spent several years as an assistant and interim manager at sc Heerenveen.
Jeff Hardeveld (born 27 February 1995) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eredivisie club Telstar.

Jelani Seedorf is a 21-year-old Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-forward for the Eredivisie club SC Telstar. Born on 12 December 2004 in Capelle aan den IJssel, he comes from a famous sporting family and is the nephew of Dutch football legend Clarence Seedorf.
Marvin Peersman (born 10 February 1991) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Eredivisie club Telstar.

Nils Rossen (born 1 August 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Telstar. Career Early years Rossen was born in Wijchen, Gelderland. As a child he played for local amateur club Alverna, and in 2013 – at age eight – he joined the Voetbal Academie NEC, the youth academy of NEC.

Noach Shenkman is a 19-year-old Dutch professional football player who plays as a defensive midfielder and center-back for the Eredivisie club SC Telstar. Born on October 2, 2006, the 1.90-meter-tall (6'3") right-footed talent recently took a major step up in his career by moving to the top tier of Dutch football.

Nökkvi Þeyr Þórisson is an Icelandic professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger. He currently represents the Dutch club Sparta Rotterdam and plays for the Iceland national team. Standing at 1.88 metres (6 feet 2 inches) tall, he is known for his versatility in attacking positions, playing both out wide and through the middle as a striker.

Patrick Brouwer (born 19 March 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie side SC Telstar. Career He is from Leiden, in South Holland. When he was twelve years-old he played youth football for Alphense Boys before joining up with Sparta Rotterdam after a year, where he initially played as a midfielder before being adapted into a wide forward.
Prince Adu-Addae Aning (born 23 April 2004) is a Dutch footballer who currently plays as a left-back for Borussia Dortmund II.

Rojendro Jeveraino Oudsten is an 18-year-old professional football player who plays as a central midfielder for the Dutch club SC Telstar. Born in Amsterdam on 12 November 2007, he is of Surinamese descent and represents Suriname internationally at the youth level.
Ronald Koeman Jr. (born 23 May 1995) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club Telstar.
Rui Jorge Monteiro Mendes (born 10 November 1999) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a right winger for Dutch Eredivisie club Telstar.

Soufiane Hetli (born 30 May 2001) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club Telstar. Born in Amsterdam, he came through the academy at AFC and holds Dutch and Moroccan nationality.

Tyrone Owusu (born 5 March 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club Telstar. He was born in the Netherlands and is of Ghanaian descent. Career Early years Owusu was born in The Hague and spent a decade in the youth system of ADO Den Haag. He joined ADO's academy as a youth and remained there until 2018, but did not break into the club's first team.
